title_ja: 当社グループが委託する生命保険募集代理店におけるランサムウェア被害について
title_en: Ransomware damage at a life insurance agency commissioned by our group
summary_en: On 5 March 2025, Fukoku Mutual Life Insurance and Fukoku Shinrai Life Insurance announced a ransomware attack on Hoken Minaoshi Honpo Group, a life insurance agency they commission. Their customers' information may have been leaked. No leak has been confirmed so far, and the agency is still investigating, as the agency's 25 February 2025 release also noted. The insurers ask customers not to respond to suspicious contacts and gave call-centre numbers for enquiries.

title_ja: 信用金庫における「しんきんらいふ年金FS〈一時払型〉」販売再開について
title_en: Resumption of sales of 'Shinkin Life Nenkin FS (single-premium type)' at shinkin banks
summary_en: Fukoku Shinrai Life Insurance announced on 31 March 2025 that it will resume sales of "Shinkin Life Nenkin FS (Lump-sum Premium Type)" on 2 April 2025. This is a yen-denominated lump-sum-premium annuity, sold through Shinkin banks (credit unions) over the counter. Applicants declare only their occupation. The death benefit never falls below the premium paid, and the accidental death benefit is 1.1 times the death benefit. Applicants can be aged 0–80, and the minimum premium is 500,000 yen.

title_ja: 当社の業務委託先におけるランサムウェア被害について
title_en: Regarding ransomware damage at our outsourcing contractor
summary_en: On 11 July 2025, Fukoku Shinrai Life Insurance announced that its contractor Shinchosha (株式会社審調社) suffered a ransomware attack, so the insurer's customer information may have been leaked. Shinchosha handles pre-underwriting checks on life insurance contracts and follow-up checks with customers whose pension claims have long been unfinished. No leak has been confirmed so far, and Shinchosha is still investigating. Customers are asked not to respond to suspicious contacts.

summary_en: Fukoku Shinrai Life announced on 24 September 2025 that it will resume sales of its yen-denominated savings annuity "Shinkin Life Nenkin FS (Accumulation Type)" through shinkin banks (credit associations) over the counter from 2 October 2025.
